intro: Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan is in Paris for the Peace Forum and bilateral talks, while domestic politics focus on an opposition politician's death in custody and the CSTO's review of Armenia's voting rights. Economic cooperation with Iran and EU integration efforts also feature prominently.

topics.title: Pashinyan in Paris for Peace Forum and bilateral meetings
topics.text: Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan attended the opening of the Child Wellbeing Summit and participated in a panel on countering hybrid threats at the Paris Peace Forum. He also held talks with French President Emmanuel Macron to review the Armenia-France strategic partnership and EU integration agenda, and met with Kosovo's Prime Minister Albin Kurti.

topics.title: Opposition politician dies in custody
topics.text: Opposition mayoral candidate Arsen Gevorgyan died in prison, with reports citing a heart attack. The incident has drawn significant attention from domestic media outlets and opposition circles.

topics.title: CSTO to review Armenia's voting rights
topics.text: The Collective Security Treaty Organization (CSTO) will decide whether to lift Armenia's voting rights, with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov confirming the discussion and stating Russia does not intend to expel Armenia. Lavrov also noted that CSTO members discussed Armenia's non-payment of membership fees.

topics.title: Armenia-Iran economic cooperation advances
topics.text: The Armenia-Iran intergovernmental commission met in Yerevan, with officials stating there is no domain where the two countries lack agreements. Long-term energy sector cooperation is envisaged, and the Iranian Vice President attended several cultural events during the visit.

topics.title: Turkey links border opening to Armenia-Azerbaijan peace deal
topics.text: Turkey has completed preparations to open border crossings with Armenia but maintains the precondition of a Yerevan-Baku peace agreement. Ankara continues to tie the normalization of relations to progress in the Armenian-Azerbaijani peace process.

topics.title: EU-Armenia partnership strengthening
topics.text: Deputy Prime Minister Mher Grigoryan reaffirmed Armenia's commitment to strengthening the EU partnership. The State Revenue Committee head is set to travel to Brussels to sign two cooperation agreements, while the PM stated Armenia is actively working with the EU to counter hybrid threats.

topics.title: Harvey Sarajian to play for Armenia national football team
topics.text: Orlando City player Harvey Sarajian has been cleared to represent the Armenia national football team. The Football Federation of Armenia confirmed the eligibility of the Armenian-American midfielder.
